```{r env-setup}
#| output: false
#| message: false
options(max.print = 999999)
here::i_am("building_models/17_four_waves_final.qmd")
source(here::here("R", "import_and_clean.R"))
source(here::here("R", "func_prep_data.R"))

pacman::p_load(data.table, here, mice, gFormulaMI, magrittr, tidyverse, colorBlindness, flextable)

seed <- 20260410
```

```{r prep-data}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pop_data <- clean_data() |> preproc_data()

# individuals in processed data
length(unique(pop_data$pidp)) #61623

# keep only people observed at both wave 2 (pre-baseline, for lagged in w3) and wave 6 (outcome)
eligible_pidp <- intersect(
  pop_data[wave == 2 & response == 1, pidp],
  pop_data[wave == 6 & response == 1, pidp]
)

length(eligible_pidp) # 23767

pop_DT <- pop_data[pidp %in% eligible_pidp]

# long format variable shifting
long_data <- pop_DT[, `:=`(
  t0 = t0 - 2L,
  pcs_lagged = shift(sf12pcs_dv, type = "lag"),
  mcs_lagged = shift(sf12mcs_dv, type = "lag"),
# the other time-varying confounders should also be lagged
  lagged_dnc = shift(dnc, type = "lag"),
  lagged_home_owner = shift(home_owner, type = "lag"),
  lagged_econ_benefits = shift(econ_benefits, type = "lag"),
  lagged_gor_dv_fact = shift(gor_dv_fact, type = "lag"),
  lagged_age_dv = shift(age_dv, type = "lag"),
  lagged_mastat_dv = shift(mastat_dv, type = "lag")
  )][wave %in% 3:6]

# keeping those with at least 2 observed MCS outcomes and no baseline missing
no_mh_outcomes <- long_data[,
  .(n_missing = sum(is.na(sf12mcs_dv)), base_missing = all(is.na(sf12mcs_dv_base))),
  by = pidp
][n_missing >= 2 & base_missing == TRUE, .(pidp)]

# how many are excluded here
length(no_mh_outcomes$pidp) # 2663

long_data <- long_data[!no_mh_outcomes, on = .(pidp)]

# matrix of possible intervention patterns for 4 time points (0: no intervention, 1: intervention)
intervention_pattern_4 <- asplit(as.matrix(CJ(0:1, 0:1, 0:1, 0:1)), 1)
```

# MCS outcome

```{r prep-data-wide-mcs}
# wide format for gformulaMI
wide_data_mcs <- long_data |>
  mutate(econ_emp_bin = as_factor(econ_emp_bin)) |>
  make_wide(
    pidp,
    t0,
    base_cols = c(sex_dv_base, # wave 1
                  race_base, # wave 1
                  hiqual_dv_base, # wave 1
                  sf12mcs_dv_base), # wave 1
    outcome = sf12mcs_dv,
    pcs_lagged,
    econ_emp_bin,
    log_income,
    lagged_dnc,
    lagged_home_owner,
    lagged_econ_benefits,
    lagged_mastat_dv,
    lagged_age_dv,
    lagged_gor_dv_fact, # wave 1
    econ_dist,
    static = FALSE,
    waves = c(0,1,2,3)
  )
```

```{r multiple-imputation-mcs}
pred_mat <- make.predictorMatrix(wide_data_mcs)

pred_mat[,c("lagged_age_dv_0", "lagged_age_dv_1", "lagged_age_dv_2", "lagged_age_dv_3")] <- 0 # collinearity
pred_mat[,c("lagged_gor_dv_fact_0", "lagged_gor_dv_fact_1", "lagged_gor_dv_fact_2", "lagged_gor_dv_fact_3")] <- 0 # collinearity across levels of the factor

mids_file_path <- "/Users/darwin.delcastillofernandez/OneDrive - University of Glasgow/output/wide_mids_mcs_4w.rds"

if (file.exists(mids_file_path)) {
  wide_mids_mcs <- readRDS(mids_file_path)
  message("Loading existing observed outcomes for MCS g-formulaMI run...")
} else {
  message("No existing observed outcomes found. Running multiple imputation for MCS outcome with 4 waves of intervention...")
wide_mids_mcs <- mice(
    wide_data_mcs,
    predictorMatrix = pred_mat,
    defaultMethod = c("norm", "logreg", "pmm", "pmm"),
    m = 50,
    maxit = 15,
    seed = seed
)
saveRDS(wide_mids_mcs, mids_file_path)
}

base_predictor_matrix_mcs <- make_predictor_matrix(wide_data_mcs) # custom g-formulaMI predictor matrix function
```

## gFormulaMI run

```{r gformulaMI-mcs}
regimes <- intervention_pattern_4

predictor_matrix <- base_predictor_matrix_mcs

# MCS does not predict intermediate outcomes
predictor_matrix[,"sf12mcs_dv_0"] <- 0
predictor_matrix[,"sf12mcs_dv_1"] <- 0
predictor_matrix[,"sf12mcs_dv_2"] <- 0

# MCS is dependent on previous MCS values
predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_1","sf12mcs_dv_0"] <- 1
predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_2","sf12mcs_dv_1"] <- 1
predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_3","sf12mcs_dv_2"] <- 1

# MCS is not predicted by baseline MCS, only by their immediate previous value
predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_1","sf12mcs_dv_base"] <- 0
predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_2","sf12mcs_dv_base"] <- 0
predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_3","sf12mcs_dv_base"] <- 0

# MCS in period t (not baseline) predicts employment and income in the period t+1
predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_0",c("econ_emp_bin_1", "log_income_1")] <- 1
predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_1",c("econ_emp_bin_2", "log_income_2")] <- 1
predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_2",c("econ_emp_bin_3", "log_income_3")] <- 1

# Economic distress does not affect income or employment of the next period
predictor_matrix["econ_dist_0",c("econ_emp_bin_1", "log_income_1")] <- 0
predictor_matrix["econ_dist_1",c("econ_emp_bin_2", "log_income_2")] <- 0
predictor_matrix["econ_dist_2",c("econ_emp_bin_3", "log_income_3")] <- 0

# MCS in wave t predicts employment at time t+1
predictor_matrix["econ_emp_bin_1", "sf12mcs_dv_0"] <- 1
predictor_matrix["econ_emp_bin_2", "sf12mcs_dv_1"] <- 1
predictor_matrix["econ_emp_bin_3", "sf12mcs_dv_2"] <- 1

# regime row always needs to be 1
predictor_matrix["regime",] <- 1

imps_file_path <- "/Users/darwin.delcastillofernandez/OneDrive - University of Glasgow/output/imps_mcs_4w.rds"

if (file.exists(imps_file_path)) {
  imps_mcs <- readRDS(imps_file_path)
  message("Loading existing imputations for MCS g-formulaMI run...")
} else {
message("No existing synthetic counterfactual imputations found. Running g-formulaMI for MCS outcome with 4 waves of intervention...")
imps_mcs <- gFormulaImpute(
    wide_mids_mcs,
    trtVars = c("econ_emp_bin_0", "econ_emp_bin_1", "econ_emp_bin_2", "econ_emp_bin_3"),
    trtRegimes = regimes,
    predictorMatrix = predictor_matrix,
    M = 200,
    silent = TRUE
)
saveRDS(imps_mcs, imps_file_path)
}

rm(wide_mids_mcs) # to save memory

fits_marginal <- imps_mcs %$%
  lm(sf12mcs_dv_3 ~ 0 + factor(regime))

fits_diff <- imps_mcs %$%
  lm(sf12mcs_dv_3 ~ factor(regime))

mi_4cummulative_mcs_marginal <- syntheticPool(fits_marginal)
mi_4cummulative_mcs_diff <- syntheticPool(fits_diff)

rm(imps_mcs, fits_marginal, fits_diff) # to save memory
```

```{r 4wavesmi-regimes-common}
regimes_4 <- tibble(intervention = regimes |>
  map(paste, collapse = "-") |>
  reduce(c)
)
```

```{r 4wavesmi-tab-mcs}
  bind_cols(regimes_4)

mod_4cummulative_mcs_diff |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)

file_name_mcs_marginal <- "/Users/darwin.delcastillofernandez/OneDrive - University of Glasgow/output/model_4w_mcs_marginal.rds"
file_name_mcs_diff <- "/Users/darwin.delcastillofernandez/OneDrive - University of Glasgow/output/model_4w_mcs_diff.rds"

  message("Model results already saved. Skipping saving step...")

saveRDS(mod_4cummulative_mcs_marginal, file_name_mcs_marginal)
saveRDS(mod_4cummulative_mcs_diff, file_name_mcs_diff)
}

# deleting objects to save memory for the next outcome
rm(mi_4cummulative_mcs_marginal, mi_4cummulative_mcs_diff, mod_4cummulative_mcs_marginal, mod_4cummulative_mcs_diff)
```

## Word export

```{r tab-4waves-word}
#| output: true

fmt <- function(est, ll, ul) sprintf("%.2f [%.2f; %.2f]", est, ll, ul)

mcs_tab <- left_join(
  readRDS("/Users/darwin.delcastillofernandez/OneDrive - University of Glasgow/output/model_4w_mcs_marginal.rds") |>
    mutate(
      n_unemp      = map_int(intervention, ~ length(str_extract_all(.x, "1", simplify = TRUE))),
      intervention = str_replace_all(intervention, c("0" = "E", "1" = "U")),
      mcs_mean     = fmt(mi_effect, mi_ll, mi_ul)
    ) |>
    select(intervention, n_unemp, mcs_mean),
  readRDS("/Users/darwin.delcastillofernandez/OneDrive - University of Glasgow/output/model_4w_mcs_diff.rds") |>
    mutate(
      intervention = str_replace_all(intervention, c("0" = "E", "1" = "U")),
      mcs_diff     = fmt(mi_effect, mi_ll, mi_ul)
    ) |>
    select(intervention, mcs_diff),
  by = "intervention"
)

pcs_tab <- left_join(
  readRDS("/Users/darwin.delcastillofernandez/OneDrive - University of Glasgow/output/model_4w_pcs_marginal.rds") |>
    mutate(
      intervention = str_replace_all(intervention, c("0" = "E", "1" = "U")),
      pcs_mean     = fmt(mi_effect, mi_ll, mi_ul)
    ) |>
    select(intervention, pcs_mean),
  readRDS("/Users/darwin.delcastillofernandez/OneDrive - University of Glasgow/output/model_4w_pcs_diff.rds") |>
    mutate(
      intervention = str_replace_all(intervention, c("0" = "E", "1" = "U")),
      pcs_diff     = fmt(mi_effect, mi_ll, mi_ul)
    ) |>
    select(intervention, pcs_diff),
  by = "intervention"
)

tab_final <- left_join(mcs_tab, pcs_tab, by = "intervention") |>
  arrange(n_unemp, intervention) |>
  select(intervention, mcs_mean, mcs_diff, pcs_mean, pcs_diff)

flextable(tab_final) |>
  set_header_labels(
    intervention = "Intervention strategy",
    mcs_mean     = "Causal mean [95% CI]",
    mcs_diff     = "Mean difference [95% CI]",
    pcs_mean     = "Causal mean [95% CI]",
    pcs_diff     = "Mean difference [95% CI]"
  ) |>
  add_header_row(
    values    = c("", "Mental Component Score (MCS)", "Physical Component Score (PCS)"),
    colwidths = c(1, 2, 2)
  ) |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  align(align = "center", part = "header") |>
  align(j = c("mcs_mean", "mcs_diff", "pcs_mean", "pcs_diff"), align = "center", part = "body") |>
  set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1) |>
  fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") |>
  add_footer_lines("Mean difference: vs always employed (E-E-E-E). Values are pooled estimates from multiple imputation (M = 50) and g-formula imputation (M = 200).") |>
  fontsize(size = 8, part = "footer") |>
  save_as_docx(path = here::here("manuscript", "table_4waves_marginal.docx"))
```

# Graphs

## Marginal estimates

```{r 4wavesmi-graph-marginal}
#| include: false

mod_4cummulative_mcs_marginal <- readRDS("/Users/darwin.delcastillofernandez/OneDrive - University of Glasgow/output/model_4w_mcs_marginal.rds")

mod_4cummulative_pcs_marginal <- readRDS("/Users/darwin.delcastillofernandez/OneDrive - University of Glasgow/output/model_4w_pcs_marginal.rds")

graph4waves_marginal <- bind_rows(
  mod_4cummulative_mcs_marginal |> mutate(outcome = "Mental Component Score (MCS)"),
  mod_4cummulative_pcs_marginal |> mutate(outcome = "Physical Component Score (PCS)")
) |>
  mutate(
    n_unemp    = map_int(intervention, ~ length(str_extract_all(.x, "1", simplify = TRUE))) |> factor(),
    intervention = str_replace_all(intervention, c("0" = "E", "1" = "U")),
    ends_unemp = str_ends(intervention, "U")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(mi_effect, intervention, xmin = mi_ll, xmax = mi_ul, colour = n_unemp, shape = ends_unemp)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  geom_errorbar(width = 0.3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = unname(paletteMartin), name = "Number of unemployed periods") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 16, "TRUE" = 18), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~outcome, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(45, 52, by = 1)) +
  expand_limits(x = 51) +
  labs(x = "Estimated marginal mean", y = "Intervention strategy") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

print(graph4waves_marginal)

ggsave(graph4waves_marginal, file = here::here("figs", "graph4waves_marginal.png"), dpi = 300, width = 8, height = 6)
```

## Mean difference

```{r 4wavesmi-graph-diff}
#| include: false

mod_4cummulative_mcs_diff <- readRDS("/Users/darwin.delcastillofernandez/OneDrive - University of Glasgow/output/model_4w_mcs_diff.rds")

mod_4cummulative_pcs_diff <- readRDS("/Users/darwin.delcastillofernandez/OneDrive - University of Glasgow/output/model_4w_pcs_diff.rds")

graph4waves_diff <- bind_rows(
  mod_4cummulative_mcs_diff |> filter(intervention != "0-0-0-0") |> mutate(outcome = "Mental Component Score (MCS)"),
  mod_4cummulative_pcs_diff |> filter(intervention != "0-0-0-0") |> mutate(outcome = "Physical Component Score (PCS)")
) |>
  mutate(
    n_unemp    = map_int(intervention, ~ length(str_extract_all(.x, "1", simplify = TRUE))) |> factor(),
    intervention = str_replace_all(intervention, c("0" = "E", "1" = "U")),
    ends_unemp = str_ends(intervention, "U")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(mi_effect, intervention, xmin = mi_ll, xmax = mi_ul, colour = n_unemp, shape = ends_unemp)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  geom_errorbar(width = 0.3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = unname(paletteMartin), name = "Number of unemployed periods") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 16, "TRUE" = 18), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~outcome, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-6, 0, by = 1)) +
  expand_limits(x = -0) +
  expand_limits(x = -6) +
  labs(x = "Estimated mean difference\n(reference: always employed, E-E-E-E)", y = "Intervention strategy") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

print(graph4waves_diff)

ggsave(graph4waves_diff, file = here::here("figs", "graph4waves_diff.png"), dpi = 300, width = 8, height = 6)
```

## Combined

```{r 4wavesmi-graph-combined}
#| output: true

library(cowplot)

graph4waves_combined <- plot_grid(
  graph4waves_marginal, graph4waves_diff,
  ncol = 1, align = "v", labels = "AUTO"
)

print(graph4waves_combined)

ggsave(graph4waves_combined, file = here::here("figs", "graph4waves_combined.png"), dpi = 300, width = 10, height = 12)
```
